+def _extract_dehumanize_word(template: Any) -> Optional[str]:
+    """Extract the literal unit word from a timeframe template.
+
+    Timeframe templates may be plain strings (e.g. ``"{0} seconds"``) or,
+    for some locales, mappings of grammatical forms (e.g. Russian).  We
+    normalise both into the literal word that identifies the unit.
+    """
+    if isinstance(template, Mapping):
+        template = template.get("plural") or next(iter(template.values()))
+    if not isinstance(template, str):
+        return None
+    word = template.replace("{0}", "").strip()
+    for article in ("a ", "an ", "1 "):
+        if word.startswith(article):
+            word = word[len(article):].strip()
+    tokens = word.split()
+    if not tokens:
+        return None
+    return tokens[-1]
+

+def _build_dehumanize_locales() -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Build the dehumanize patterns for every registered locale.
+

+    expects, for each locale, a mapping with the past/future indicator
+    words and a mapping of unit words to their canonical time unit names.
+    """
+    from arrow import locales
+
+    patterns: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    for name, locale_cls in locales._locale_map.items():
+        locale = locale_cls()
+        past = locale.past.replace("{0}", "").strip()
+        future = locale.future.replace("{0}", "").strip()
+        units: Dict[str, str] = {}
+        for unit_name, template in locale.timeframes.items():
+            if unit_name == "now":
+                continue
+            word = _extract_dehumanize_word(template)
+            if word:
+                units[word.lower()] = unit_name
+        patterns[name] = {
+            "past": [past] if past else [],
+            "future": [future] if future else [],
+            "units": units,
+        }
+    return patterns
